Why kindness can feel threatening: understanding fear of compassion.

For some people, kindness from others or from themselves brings up discomfort, doubt or sadness. Psychologists call this fear of compassion, and research links fear of self-compassion and fear of receiving kindness with mental health difficulties. It often makes sense, and it can be worked with slowly.
